style.styleTitle: Homcom 6ft Light Prelit Artificial Christmas Tree With 230 LEDs and Sstar Topper
style.toneOfVoice: <p>Light up your home with pure magic this season thanks to this 6FT Christmas tree from HOMCOM. Its artificial design will last for several years, making it a safe choice for homes with children and pets. The realistic tree is equipped with fibre-optic LED lights, featuring a mix of warm white lights and small balls for a bright and beautiful effect. The large number of branches is capable of supporting your hanging decorations and tinsel, allowing you to create a personalized look. This tree is a beautiful way to create an extra-special atmosphere in your home.</p><ul><li>Features 230 lights, which shine brightly in a lovely mix of fibre optic tips and balls.</li><li>Four pre-set light patterns allow you to easily switch up the flashing effects.</li><li>Comes with a star topper, meaning you won't need an additional angel or star.</li><li>The base ensures the tree remains balanced and stable, and the full-bodied design makes it stand proudly in any room, whether at home or in the office.</li><li>The branches can easily support your own decorations and tinsel, and the tree is easy to assemble.</li><li>The tree is green with white lights, and the materials include PVC branches and a metal base.</li></ul><p><strong>Product Specifications:</strong></p><ul><li>Dimensions: 180H x F84 cm</li><li>Electric cable length: 180cm</li><li>Branch tip count: 230</li><li>LED light count: 230</li><li>Input: 100-240V 50/60Hz</li><li>Output: 12V/12W</li><li>Please note: UK mainland delivery only.</li></ul>
